fingerprint_definition.ordered: SHA256 of 36 bytes v0.xyz,v1.xyz,v2.xyz exactly as little-endian float32 in binary STL; normals and attribute excluded.
fingerprint_definition.oriented_cyclic: SHA256 of byte-lexicographically minimum of the 3 cyclic rotations of those 12-byte vertices; never reverse winding, round, weld, or alter signed zero.
